fault_desc: unlogged wrong port, then benign payment release
diagnosis: Synthetic checkout journeys went from 7/10 OK to 0/20 OK. Checkout returns fast HTTP 500s, then timeouts. The only change in the last 60 minutes is payment release 1.8.3 (ci-bot, 18:18:21), 4 seconds before the alert. Payment's own pod is Ready with 0 restarts, and its 5-minute Charge error count is 0. Checkout PlaceOrder shows about 124 errors in 5 minutes, but payment Charge traffic is only about 8 calls in that window, so checkout appears to fail before reaching payment. That makes payment 1.8.3 a plausible trigger but not confirmed. Checkout's own deployment has not changed since 16:59. A rollback of payment is not verified to fix this, so I'm escalating rather than acting. A human should check checkout's error logs (its container logs were empty) and decide whether to roll back payment to revision 66.
